name: browser_navigate
description: Open a URL in the operator's active browser tab.

url.description: Absolute URL to open in the operator's active tab.

name: browser_read_table
description: Read a table from the operator's active tab as structured rows.

selector.description: CSS selector for the table element, e.g. '#shipments'.

name: browser_read_text
description: Read visible text from the operator's active tab.

selector.description: CSS selector to read text from.

name: browser_click
description: Click an element in the operator's active tab.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click.

text.description: Optional visible text to match instead of a selector.

name: browser_fill
description: Set the value of an input or select element.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input or select element.

name: browser_wait_for
description: Wait for an element to appear in the operator's active tab.

name: ops_node_capacity
description: Look up crane hours, berth slots and congestion at a port node. Must be called before recommending crane reallocation.

node.description: Destination or intermediate port name, e.g. 'Rotterdam'.

name: ops_carrier_policy
description: Look up carrier policy on port call swaps, omissions, cost bands and notice hours.
